Olivia K.: heads up — noticed a weird bump in prorated token credits at the top of the hour, invoice preview shows ~3.2% higher than expected for a handful of tenants
Raj P.: Ugh. Which window? hourly, hourly+prorate? any tenant pattern?
Olivia K.: looks like the prorate window is overlapping the ingest heartbeat by one minute for routes with late-arrive sessions. Affected tenants are all with route_tag=embed-heavy
Ben L.: can you paste the query you used to surface this? i want to run it scoped to a sample tenant
Olivia K.: here — ran against tally snapshots: ```SELECT tenant_id, sum(prorated_tokens) as s, window_start FROM tallies WHERE window_start BETWEEN '2026-03-15T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T01:00:00Z' AND route_tag='embed-heavy' GROUP BY tenant_id, window_start ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 50;```
MeteringBot: alert: ingest-heartbeat-delay detected (median 78s) affecting 12 shards — link: https://console/redwood/ingest/alerts/5699
Raj P.: 78s heartbeat delay would definitely push some events into the next prorate bucket. is this a router fanout issue or upstream queue lag?
Sara C.: @Raj P. we saw a deploy to ingestion fanout yesterday that changed max_inflight from 200->500; hypothesis: burst smoothing + acks changed ordering under backpressure
Ben L.: if ordering shifted, dedupe/fingerprint window might be misaligned with the prorate aggregation watermark. quick mitigation: expand the prorate cutover grace to 90s and re-run previews
Tim O.: expanding grace will impact invoice determinism though — customers will see shifted credits for that hour. Are we sure it's safe to change without a migration note?
Olivia K.: agreed. proposal: 1) apply a canary change to preview only (grace=90s) for 2 tenants, 2) re-run preview diff, 3) if <0.5% delta, rollout to previews and schedule invoice freeze/backfill plan
Raj P.: +1 for preview-first. i'll open a short-lived feature flag: `prorate_preview_grace_seconds=90` scoped to tenant ids [t-123, t-456]
Ben L.: FYI for the SRE play: add a trace id to the heartbeat path so we can correlate late events to the specific shard instance. small patch: ```ctx = ctx.with_trace_id(shard_id) // pass through fanout```
MeteringBot: task created: INGEST-1227 Add trace id on heartbeat path — assigned to Ben L. — due 2026-03-18
Sara C.: also add a dashboard card: "prorate cutover misalignments" that shows count of events crossing window boundaries, and median heartbeat latency per shard
Tim O.: make sure billing/product are pinged before any invoice-backfill. i'll draft the customer communication templates if we need a visible rollback
Olivia K.: thanks all — steps: Raj canary flag, Ben trace id + dashboard card, Sara add preview card, Tim comms ready. i'll run preview diffs and post results here in ~30m :eyes:
Raj P.: noted, flipping the canary now :rocket:
Ben L.: starting patch, will mark PR wip
MeteringBot: deploybot: canary flag toggled for tenants t-123,t-456 by Raj P.
Olivia K.: (after) preview diffs: tenant t-123 delta 0.31%, t-456 delta 0.19% — looks safe to propagate to full preview rollout. filing followups for backfill plan. :white_check_mark:
